stem: Chọn đáp án đúng để hoàn thành câu sau theo thì hiện tại đơn (Present Simple tense): 'Every morning, my father ___ to work by bike.'
source: Global Success 9 – Grammar: Present Simple tense

stem: Chọn đáp án đúng để hoàn thành câu sau theo thì quá khứ đơn (Past Simple tense): 'Last summer, we ___ Da Lat with our family.'
source: Global Success 9 – Grammar: Past Simple tense

stem: Từ vựng nào sau đây thuộc chủ đề City life (cuộc sống thành thị) trong chương trình Tiếng Anh 9?
source: Tiếng Anh 9 (thí điểm) – Unit 2: City life

stem: Chuyển câu chủ động sau sang câu bị động (Passive voice): 'They built this bridge in 1990.'
distractors: This bridge has been built in 1990.
source: Global Success 9 – Unit 3: Passive Voice (Simple Past)

stem: Chuyển câu trực tiếp sau sang câu tường thuật (Reported speech): She said, 'I am watching TV now.'
correct: She said (that) she was watching TV then.
distractors: She said that she is watching TV now.
She said that she watches TV now.
She says that she was watching TV then.

stem: Chọn đáp án đúng để hoàn thành câu so sánh hơn và nhất (Comparatives and superlatives): 'Mount Everest is ___ mountain in the world.'
source: Global Success 9 – Grammar: Comparatives and Superlatives

stem: Chọn động từ khuyết thiếu (Modal verbs) phù hợp nhất để đưa ra lời khuyên (Giving advice) trong câu sau: 'You look tired. I think you ___ get some rest.'
Câu nào sau đây sử dụng đúng cấu trúc điều kiện loại 2 (Second conditional), phân biệt với điều kiện loại 1 (First conditional)?
correct: If I had more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
distractors: If I have more free time, I will learn to play the guitar.
If I had more free time, I will learn to play the guitar.
If I have had more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
source: Global Success 9 – Grammar: Conditional Sentences Type 1 & 2

stem: Câu nào sau đây sử dụng đúng mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (Non-defining relative clauses), phân biệt với mệnh đề quan hệ xác định (Defining relative clauses)?
correct: My father, who has worked as an engineer for 20 years, is going to retire next year.
distractors: My father who has worked as an engineer for 20 years is going to retire next year.
My father, that has worked as an engineer for 20 years, is going to retire next year.
My father which has worked as an engineer for 20 years is going to retire next year.
source: Global Success 9 – Grammar: Relative Clauses (Defining vs Non-defining)

stem: Chọn câu đúng theo cấu trúc điều kiện loại 3 (Third conditional), diễn tả một điều kiện không có thật trong quá khứ, để hoàn thành ý: 'Cô ấy bị điểm thấp trong kỳ thi vì không học chăm chỉ.'
correct: If she had studied harder for the exam, she wouldn't have got such a low mark.
distractors: If she studied harder for the exam, she wouldn't get such a low mark.
If she had studied harder for the exam, she wouldn't get such a low mark.
If she has studied harder for the exam, she won't have got such a low mark.
source: Global Success 9 – Grammar: Conditional Sentences Type 3
